thread:
tara: Quick sync — finalizing eligibility matrix for the mini-pilot (Edge-tier + Priority Lane add-on). Need launch criteria, enforcement model, and a short FAQ by EOD.
anika: Do we want Priority Lane purchasable a la carte, or only as an add-on to specific tiers? Sales pushed a la carte asks.
mike: Tech constraints: route-level isolation is doable but increases billing complexity and cache separation.
lisa: Sales note — at least two pilot customers explicitly asked for route-scoped Priority (only apply to search routes). They want it without moving to Dedicated.
oliver: Ops caution — route-scoped + per-route quotas can lead to double-counting if a customer routes requests across endpoints. Prefer a single envelope if possible.
tara: Proposal: support two modes for pilot: 1) tenant-global Priority (default) 2) route-bound Priority (opt-in). Route-bound allowed only for pilot customers and subject to summed caps.
jen: Finance — need a minimum revenue floor: Priority Lane must be >= $2k/mo per tenant in pilot, or we gate purchase behind a minimum seat/commit. Also require overage policy.
anika: Product gating metrics suggestion: adoption by >=3 customers, P95 latency delta < +30ms vs baseline, error rate <1%, clear billing reconciliation flow.
mike: Implementation detail — route-binding requires separate KV namespaces. Suggested keying: `tenant:{tenant_id}:route:{route_id}:priority`.

```yaml
# enforcement sketch
modes:
  - global
  - route_bound
route_bound:
  cap_tokens_per_day: 50000
  aggregated_envelope: true
``` 

lisa: For messaging: sales page needs clear bullets: how caps aggregate, how billing shows up, and an explicit "route opt-in" checkbox.
oliver: Ops asks for an automated guardrail: if aggregated usage across routes hits 90% of cap, send 72h notice + auto-fallback to global mode unless customer approves extension.
tara: Decision (tentative): ship pilot with both modes; route-bound available only by request and subject to 50k token/day aggregated cap. Add a 90% guardrail notification and auto-fallback policy.
jen: Finance: add trial credit for first month? Fine if credits are explicit and flagged in billing export.
anika: Next steps: @mike prototype enforcement + metrics (deadline Wed), @lisa draft sales FAQ + pricing blurb (tomorrow), @tara prepare pilot acceptance checklist and sign-off template.
mike: One more tech FYI — function/tool-calls with streaming may complicate token counting slightly; we'll standardize on server-side tokenization for billing.
finance-bot: Reminder: update the ratecard spreadsheet with Priority Lane sku id = PRIO-P1 and attach to pilot contract.

tara: Thanks — posting summary to product-docs once actions are captured. :thumbsup:
mike: Will add a short test harness and a sample invoice output by end of day.
lisa: Scheduling 1:1 with pilot customers to confirm route mapping.
anika: I'll coordinate signups and collect success metrics set. :rocket:
